newsitem.title: UK: Oil tanker floating storage down in November.
newsitem.headline: Oil tanker floating storage down in November.

text.p: A total of 72 oil tankers were used as floating storage in November compared to 75 in October, shipbrokers Jacobs and Partners said on Wednesday.

In tonnage terms, 12,508,911 deadweight tonnes (dwt) was used for floating storage in November. Of this, 48 vessels (7,753,789 dwt) were in the semi-permanent sector while 15 (2,900,887 dwt) were short term.
The number of tankers in the fixed forward sector totalled nine (1,854,235 dwt.)
